scenario_description:
Objective: Use a short recycling-cart opening to make Sunday's storage-cage reset remove a sealed spent plotter cartridge.
Emerging Need: A disposal chance is speculative until the cart's accepted-item rules, capacity, and intake contact align before the same-day list closes.
Decision Context: The activity log identifies the exact cartridge model and location; live building notices establish the route, handling limits, and cutoff.
Consequence: Ignoring the chance leaves the cartridge stored harmlessly, while after list lock the optional decluttering and recycling benefit cannot be included in this run.

parameter.title: Storage cage shelf reset
parameter.description: Clear one shelf and update the small-supplies bin labels.

parameter.subject: Sunday green cart: cartridge and compact e-waste run
parameter.body: A volunteer green cart will make one resident drop-off run tomorrow for spent wide-format printer or plotter ink cartridges and compact e-waste. Eligible cartridge items must be named in advance; the intake contact will be posted after noon. The accepted-item list closes today at 15:30, and unlisted walk-ups will stay with residents.

parameter.content: Green cart supply note: the cartridge bin has room for eight resident cartridges. Items must stay sealed in their return sleeves, and accepted residents should bring them to the lobby table by Sunday 10:00; no storage-cage entry or package-room drop-offs are part of the run.

parameter.name: Priya Shah - Green Cart Intake
parameter.notes: Rostered for the July 19 resident cartridge run. Email item model and unit number before 15:30 on 2026-07-18; accepted residents bring sealed items to the lobby table Sunday morning.

parameter.subject: Green cart list locked for Sunday run
parameter.body: The 15:30 accepted-item list for tomorrow's green cart is now locked so the volunteers can sort bins and labels tonight. New resident recycling requests received after this point will be held for the September collection.
